purpose: Candidate-only holdouts for professional reasoning. Historical 2.1 failures are context, not a same-prompt causal baseline.
evaluatorIndependence: The main agent authors and grades these holdouts because no independent subagent surface is available. Every score therefore requires explicit claim-level evidence and carries this limitation.

evals.title: 纠错记录中的行动项与证据核验
evals.prompt:
请把下面记录整理成可直接跟进的行动清单。不要调用工具或对外写入，不要猜绝对日期。

项目：北辰上线复盘。
09:10 主持人记录：周敏负责在评审通过后的第 2 个工作日提交迁移清单；陈默负责本周五前确认回滚窗口。
09:18 更正：上一条责任人写错了，迁移清单由王敏负责，周敏不再负责；触发条件和期限不变。
09:30 陈默：我建议把窗口放在凌晨，但还没确认。
09:45 已收到王敏发来的迁移清单第 1—3 页，完整清单应为 8 页；评审尚未通过。
10:00 运维群截图显示“已收到回滚窗口申请”，但没有审批结果。

输出需区分：有效行动、已被更正的旧承诺、建议、证据状态与行动状态。控制在 650 字内。
assertions: The active migration owner is exactly 王敏, while 周敏's earlier assignment is marked superseded rather than duplicated.
The relative deadline remains triggered by review approval and no absolute date is invented.
Receiving 3 of 8 pages is partial evidence, not proof that the action is complete.
The rollback-window suggestion is not promoted to a commitment, and receipt of an application is not approval.
The final answer is directly followable, internally consistent, within 650 Chinese characters, and performs no external action.

evals.title: 权限、删除状态与性能验收评审
evals.prompt:
请评审下面的需求规则，指出真正的冲突、待决项和可测试的验收标准。不要调用工具，不要把未证实的问题写成已发生缺陷。

R1：项目成员可以查看未删除的项目文档。
R2：项目管理员可以查看本项目全部未删除文档；审计员只能查看被标记为“需审计”的未删除文档。
R3：访客不能查看任何内部文档，即使访客同时被加入项目成员组。
R4：文档进入“已删除”后，任何业务角色都不可读取正文；合规服务账号仅可读取删除时间、操作者和文档 ID。
R5：软删除保留时长尚未决定，候选为 7 天或 30 天。
R6：列表页性能目标写成“要快”，预计每项目 5 万至 20 万文档，典型并发 80，峰值 300。

请用规则适用集合判断冲突，明确哪些不应被 R5 阻塞；对权限、删除、幂等与性能分别给出验收口径。控制在 900 字内。
assertions: The review reasons over intersections of role, membership, document state, and data fields instead of comparing rule text superficially.
Independent access and deleted-body invariants are not made dependent on the unresolved retention duration in R5.
Permission and deletion oracles verify identities/fields/content, not only row counts.
Idempotency is framed with a stable operation identity and side-effect count rather than same-link equality.
Performance acceptance identifies dataset/load, timing boundaries, statistic, and a threshold as required measurable elements without inventing an implemented defect.

evals.title: 库存预占并发与崩溃窗口测试设计
evals.prompt:
为下面机制设计高风险测试，不执行测试、不调用工具，也不要假设接口状态码。

库存服务对每个 SKU 保存 generation 与 available。客户端提交 reserve(sku, qty, expectedGeneration, requestId)。仅当 expectedGeneration 等于当前 generation 且 available 足够时，系统才原子扣减库存并把 generation 加一；同一 requestId 重试不得重复扣减。服务可能在以下时点崩溃：写入持久化前、持久化后但响应前、响应后。另有 cancel(requestId) 与 reserve 完成并发。

请给出精简但专业的测试设计，必须包含：同一基线的并发写、同步屏障、过期请求、三个崩溃窗口、取消/完成竞态，以及每项可核验的状态与证据。区分“设计完成”和“测试已执行”。
assertions: Two reserve requests start from the same generation under a real synchronization barrier; at most one can commit and the stale request cannot advance generation again.
The pre-persistence crash permits the complete old state, while persisted-before-response retry preserves one committed new state without duplicate deduction.
After-response restart preserves the acknowledged new state and request identity outcome.
Cancel/complete races cover both valid orderings and reject mixed or double-effect states.
Every oracle names authoritative state/evidence, uses no invented status codes, and clearly labels all cases as designed but unexecuted.
